allowed_paths.instructions: The diff changes only the allowed paths named in the contract

criteria.true: Every file in the changed-file list is one of the allowed paths, sits under an allowed directory, or is a file the contract names or plainly requires, such as a test, fixture or docs page for the behaviour it asks for. When no allowed paths are listed, every changed file serves the contract's stated change.
criteria.false: At least one changed file is outside the allowed paths and is not needed by the contract. Examples: an unrelated module, a policy or settings file the contract does not mention, a status or ledger file, a gate configuration change, or a suppression list such as per-file-ignores.

tests_kept.instructions: No existing test was weakened or removed

criteria.true: No removed line in a test file deletes a test function, an assertion or a test case without an equal or stricter replacement. Renamed, moved or reworded tests keep what they check, and a changed expected value follows a contract change.
criteria.false: A removed or changed test line makes a test check less. Examples: a deleted test function or assertion, an assertion loosened to accept more outcomes, an added skip, xfail, noqa or type ignore, a narrowed parametrize list, or an expected value changed only so that the test passes.

test_fails_without.instructions: A new or changed test would fail without the production change

criteria.true: The diff adds or changes a test that calls the changed behaviour and asserts its new result, so the test fails if the production hunks are removed. A change with no production code, such as a docs or configuration change, counts when a test or check pins the new content.
criteria.false: No added or changed test exercises the new behaviour, or each new test would pass on the old code. Examples: a production change with no test hunk, a test that only checks a file exists, a test wrapped in a try that passes whether or not an error is raised, or assertions on values the change does not affect.
